description_for_human: Search a directory of AI products, and grade any website for how readable it is to AI agents.
description_for_model: Use this to search a curated directory of AI products, APIs, agents and MCP servers, and to grade any public URL for agent-readability across 13 checks (llms.txt, schema.org JSON-LD, robots.txt AI-crawler posture, sitemap, agent card, machine-readable alternates, canonical, HTTPS). Products can also register themselves autonomously. Full protocol in llms.txt.
